review: N673 doctor and updater follow-up. Preserve the supported no-wgpu install choice, ordered rendering fallback, import versus adapter failures, commands, versions and every format placeholder. CPU, OpenGL, VisPy, wgpu, uv, Python, Linux, glibc, Vulkan, Metal, Direct3D 12, spaCR and the True 3D view name remain literal technical identities. Independent technical peer review included composed fallback grammar and supported-install meaning; normal runtime generation and gates remain required.
